history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration improve the maintenance of the audit trail to enable a better review of the cash position at the fund level.
history.administration_response: Inter-fund transfers are authorized by the Administration in order to ensure liquidity and that balances are monitored on a daily basis. All loans are recorded in Umoja and can be tracked down.
history.board_assessment: The Board noticed that it was possible to balance fund values through inter- fund transfers even after the close of the financial year. Therefore, it was difficult to analyse and determine the exact instances of negative balances and level of cash balances at the fund level at any given date. In addition, no documentation for improvements in maintenance of audit trail was provided. The Board considers this recommendation to be not implemented.

history.reference_raw: Report of the Board for the year ended 31 December 2018 9
history.entities_raw: Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance
history.sg_progress: The Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget monitors the cash balances of the participating fund, and this information is communicated on a daily basis to the Office of the Controller. The audit trail already exists in Umoja, as the system records the time and date of the entry (entry date) and the effective date of the transaction (posting date), which can be used to determine the daily cash balances. The Administration considers this recommendation to have been implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
